title: Refute three named claims in the session orchestration report
final_text:
Both scripts rerun cleanly (exit code 0) and every figure quoted in the findings file matches the computed output. The work is done.

## What I did

I read the three §4 "Live spend" claims out of `docs/reviews/session-orchestration-report-2026-09-14.md`, located both receipt sets (`C001-contrast-triple/occurrence-01`: 240 receipts in 12 cells of 20; `F001-fork5-multifamily`: 63 receipts in occurrences 01–06 plus 20 in 07–08), and verified every clause of every claim by aggregation — nothing eyeballed, no published file modified.

## Files written

- `check/refute_claims.py` — walks all C001 occurrence-01 and F001 receipts; counts failure codes/types, per-cell statuses, provider-side fields, envelope repairs and strict-parse flags.
- `check/refute_claims_tail.py` — per-coordinate cross-checks (usage/reasoning tokens, repair×strict cross-tab, OPAQUE/AUTHORED envelopes, deepseek-flash control-arm figures).
- `out/refutations.md` — the findings, with the exact aggregation, the printed output, and a verdict per claim.

## Verdicts (last run: both scripts exit 0)

- **CLAIM 1 — REFUTED IN PART.** The count survives: exactly 20 `INCOMPLETE_GENERATION` receipts = 11 FAILED + 9 PARTIAL. The attribution clause does not: the `deepseek-flash`×`fcl` cell carries only **8** PARTIAL; the ninth is `ollama-glm-5.3/fcl/control/rep2.json` (PARTIAL, `completion_tokens: 32768`). And "the provider raising it on both" holds for the nine PARTIAL (which record `provider_status: INCOMPLETE_GENERATION`) but is unsupported for the eleven FAILED, whose provider-side fields are all null (`provider_status`, `finish_reason`, `usage`) — the code sits in the receipt's own `failure_type` beside `validation_failure_type: NO_PUBLIC_CONTENT`.
- **CLAIM 2 — SURVIVES.** All seven v1 failures (five FAILED, two PARTIAL, all on occurrences 04/05) are at `finish_reason: length`, exactly 8,192 completion tokens; exactly the five FAILED carry no `artifact_sha256`, matching "five returning zero bytes", while the two PARTIAL carry one. One stated limit: this sandbox slice of F001 contains no delivered-bytes files, so the byte figure rests on those null-artifact markers rather than measurable bytes.
- **CLAIM 3 — SURVIVES.** `envelope_repairs` non-empty on 93 of 240 (`strip_outer_code_fence` 92 at one receipt each — zero multi-repair receipts — plus `json_strict_false` 1 at `ollama-glm-5.3/prose/carrier/rep4`); `strict_parse_would_succeed` true on 122 (false 107, null 11; 122+107+11 = 240).

**Clause the record does not support:** Claim 1's "the nine PARTIAL of the `deepseek-flash` × `fcl` cell" (refuted by the named `ollama-glm-5.3/fcl/control/rep2.json`), and, within that claim, "the provider raising it on both" for the eleven FAILED receipts — the receipts are silent provider-side on those eleven, so this is recorded as unsupported, not contradicted. An incidental finding surfaced by the same scripts: the report's own §2 sentence "19 of its 20 coordinates carry `completion_tokens` exactly 8,192 … eleven spent the entire ceiling on reasoning" is also not supported by the receipts (only 8 coordinates at 8,192; the eleven FAILED have `usage: null`) — flagged in the findings file separately from the three claims.
